# Version 4.148.1 (Unreleased)
> **macOS typeface race fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.1 updates Skia m148 to resolve a macOS typeface stream data race.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **macOS typeface stream access is thread-safe** — The bundled Skia m148 engine resolves a race on `fStream` in `SkTypeface_Mac` during concurrent typeface cache access. ([#4262](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4262))
